command:
export OLLAMA_MODELS=$HOME/.cache/cloudpc-models/ollama-models
OBIN=$(find $HOME/.cache/cloudpc-models/ollama-bin -name ollama -type f 2>/dev/null | head -1)
echo "OBIN=$OBIN"; free -g; df -h $HOME | tail -1
[ -z "$OBIN" ] && { echo NO_BIN; exit 1; }
export OLLAMA_HOST=127.0.0.1:11434
$OBIN serve > /tmp/ollama.log 2>&1 &
sleep 8
$OBIN list
echo ---API-RAW---
curl -s -m 120 -X POST http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/chat -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"qwen2.5-coder:14b","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Reply with exactly: SELFTEST OK"}],"stream":false,"options":{"num_ctx":2048}}' | head -c 600
echo
echo ---LOG---
tail -20 /tmp/ollama.log
